proposals.evidence: The Badaga dictionary p8 gives aṅgālu feet/footprint/sole and explicitly cites7. DEDR7 itself lists the complete Kannada aṅ-gāl, Kodagu aŋgālï and Tulu aṅgārů sole-of-foot formations. DravLex angālə foot is proposed under that whole article, preserving its broader foot gloss and final central vowel; it is not equated with bare akam.

proposals.evidence: The Badaga kollu entry p219 gives kobb-/kodd- kill/murder and cites2132, whose full article contains the kol/koll killing family. DravLex koppə is proposed through that local geminate-stop paradigm, with voiceless pp versus printed bb explicitly retained; this is qualified comparative evidence, not an exact dictionary form.

proposals.evidence: The cached Badaga entry p28 contains ari know (ariv-, arid-) with314, and the arivu/aruvu entry gives knowledge/understanding with the same citation. DEDR314 independently includes Kannada aṟavu knowledge and Kodagu ari-/ariv-. DravLex aravə know is proposed in this whole family, preserving its vowel sequence, complete ending and verbal gloss; the OCR’s merged sheaf/know entry is not treated as one homonym.
